---
title: "Greener Pastures: Reducing Small-Business Emissions Through Route Optimization"
description: >-
  Can smarter routing make a small business greener? Using real Mother's Day 2025 delivery
  data from a Pennsylvania florist, I compared the shop's manual routes with routes
  optimized by VROOM and OSRM. The optimized plan saved 89 minutes, 66.8 miles, 4 delivery
  trips and $512.36, with a measurable drop in carbon emissions.

**Now an open-source tool.** [The Benevolent Bandwidth Foundation](https://benevolentbandwidth.org/) selected this project to be fully prototyped and open-sourced as the [Delivery Optimizer](https://delivery-optimizer--b2-delivery-optimizer.us-east4.hosted.app/), which lets small businesses upload their delivery addresses and get back an efficient route. The code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/benevolentbandwidth/delivery-optimizer), and there's a write-up on [Medium](https://medium.com/@kkovalenko_86987/b0af9a0133ef).
